Getting Set Up

Do all of this in the first week of the semester. Some steps take a few days to go through, so don’t leave them for later.

A Notebook and a Pen

For your Worm Journal: a paper notebook of your own, and a pen that writes in ink.

Scanning Your Journal

Periodically you will scan pages of your Worm Journal and submit them to Canvas as a PDF. Your phone can do this; you do not need a scanner.
